title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يشارك فى المؤتمر العالمي الأول للباحثين فى القرءان الكريم وعلومه .
title_en: His Eminence the Sheikh Takes Part in the First World Conference of Researchers in the Noble Qur'an and its Sciences
body_ar: شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو بصفته رئيسا لمركز تكوين العلماء ومستشارا فى الهيئة العالمية للإعجاز ، ونائبا عن رئيس الإتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين فى المؤتمر العالمي الأول للباحثين فى القرءان الكريم وعلومه ، والذى احتضنته مدينة فاس المغربية فى الفترة مابين : 10-12 جمادى الأولى 1432ه الموافق ل14-16 إبريل 2011م . وقد نظم المؤتمر هذه السنة تحت شعار : جهود الأمة فى خدمة القرءان الكريم وعلومه . وقد ألقى فضيلة الشيخ فى الحفل الافتتاحي للمؤتمر كلمة باسم رئيس الإتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين فضيلة الشيخ يوسف القرضاوي قال فيها إن الله عزوجل شرف الأمة بهذا الكتاب العزيز ، الذى خدمته مختلف أجيالها من لدن الصحابة رضوان الله عليهم إلى علماء الأمة عبر العصور ، وقال فضيلته إن هذا العصر توفرت فيه الوسائل بشكل كبير وأن سلف الأمة من العلماء الكبار كانوا يبذلون الجهود المضنية لخدمة كتاب الله العزيز . كما كانت للشيخ مشاركات قيمة فى مختلف فعاليات المؤتمر . وسنوافيكم فى إدارة الموقع بملف كامل عن مشاركات الشيخ فى هذا المؤتمر المهم وذالك فى وقت لاحق بإذن الله تعالى ولمتابعة كلمة الشيخ فى الحفل الإفتتاحى : اضغط هنا
body_en:
His eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew took part — in his capacity as head of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, as an adviser in the World Authority for Inimitability, and as deputy for the president of the International Union of Muslim Scholars — in the First World Conference of Researchers in the Noble Qur'an and its Sciences, which the Moroccan city of Fez hosted in the period 10–12 Jumada al-Ula 1432 AH, corresponding to 14–16 April 2011 CE. The conference was organised this year under the banner: "The efforts of the community in the service of the Noble Qur'an and its sciences".

At the conference's opening ceremony his eminence the Sheikh delivered an address in the name of the president of the International Union of Muslim Scholars, his eminence Sheikh Yusuf al-Qaradawi, in which he said that God, mighty and majestic, honoured the community with this mighty Book, which its various generations have served, from the Companions — may God be pleased with them — down to the scholars of the community across the ages. His eminence said that in this age the means have become abundantly available, whereas the community's forebears among the great scholars used to expend exhausting efforts in the service of God's mighty Book. The Sheikh also made valuable contributions in the conference's various events.

We in the site's administration will furnish you with a complete file on the Sheikh's contributions to this important conference, at a later time, God Most High willing.

flags.note: The body is named here only as 'the World Authority for Inimitability'. Organisations of this name are normally styled more fully, with the subject matter of the iʿjāz specified. The short form is rendered exactly as served and no fuller name has been supplied, since supplying one would be an identification the record does not make. The Sheikh's office should give the organisation's own English name before publication, as with the Centre for the Formation of Scholars and the International Union of Muslim Scholars.

flags.arabic: كلمة باسم رئيس الإتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين فضيلة الشيخ يوسف القرضاوي
flags.context: the capacity in which the opening address was given
options: make clear that he spoke on the president's behalf, not as the president
attribute the address to him personally
flags.note: Important for attribution. The Sheikh delivered the address in the name of, and as deputy for, Sheikh Yusuf al-Qaradawi as president of the Union. The words reported are therefore his delivery of an address given on another's behalf, and should not be catalogued as his own statement without that qualification. The English states the capacity in both places where the record gives it.

flags.note: This item is the most heavily non-standard in the slice for orthography: 'القرءان' with a free-standing hamza for 'القرآن'; the dotless yāʾ in 'فى', 'الذى', 'والذى', 'الإفتتاحى'; 'وذالك' for 'وذلك'; 'عزوجل' and 'مابين' run together; 'الإتحاد' with hamzat qaṭʿ for 'الاتحاد'; and 'هـ' written as plain hāʾ after the Hijri year. All are left as served in body_ar. The pattern suggests this item was typed by a different hand from the rest of the section.

translator_notes: A short site news notice reporting attendance at a conference, not a text by the Sheikh.
The dual dating is the source's own and is kept in both calendars.
As in records 680 and 684, the item closes by promising that the Sheikh's contributions will be published separately; if they were, they are primary material where this notice is not.

The page ends with a navigation line inviting the reader to click through to the recording in the site's separate media system; it is a site affordance rather than content and is not part of body_ar or body_en.
